text: A model only Felix Granger fully understands is a liability the moment he's unavailable. This video writes the actual model card and handoff doc.
It states the real, validated accuracy plainly: AUC ~0.79, on a time-consistent backtest -- not the invalid 0.98 from the original, leaky model.
The leakage incident gets documented as a named lesson learned, with the exact mechanism and the exact fix, so nobody repeats it later.
Ownership is named, not assumed: Felix Granger on the model, Grace Lindqvist on the Azure deployment, Renata Silva on the source data.
Retraining is manual, roughly quarterly -- stated honestly, not hidden. Next: the series finale, naming what shipped and what's still manual.
